description: This file defines classes, structs, and enums related to UE (User Equipment) resource allocation in a cellular network scheduler, including requests for grants, grant builders, and the main allocator class for scheduling PDCCH, UCI, PDSCH, and PUSCH resources.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator
classes.description: Main class responsible for allocating PDCCH, UCI, PDSCH, and PUSCH resources for UE grants within a cell.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator::dl_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Builder class for deferred configuration of DL PDSCH grant parameters.

classes.name: ue_cell_grid_allocator::ul_newtx_grant_builder
classes.description: Builder class for deferred configuration of UL PUSCH grant parameters.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant
methods.description: Allocates a DL grant for a UE and returns a builder to set PDSCH parameters.

methods.name: allocate_dl_grant (reTx)
methods.description: Allocates a DL grant for a UE HARQ re-transmission.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant
methods.description: Allocates a UL grant for a UE and returns a builder to set PUSCH parameters.

methods.name: allocate_ul_grant (reTx)
methods.description: Allocates a UL grant for a UE HARQ re-transmission.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Finalizes resource allocations at the end of a slot, possibly resizing grants.
